**Considering display settings**

I’m thinking about whether to show text size and haptics under the "DISPLAY" or “SOUND” group. Right now, they’re part of the displayRows in the Cassette group on the CassetteScreenConfig case. The instruction mentions placing controls below the screen setting, so I wonder if we should move the variant row directly under the screen row and keep the text size and haptics options where they are. It’s all about preserving that existing functionality! Where's the best placement?

**Adjusting group settings**

I’m planning to move the _Cycle variant row into the LOOK group right after the screen cycle row. The rest of the Cassette-specific settings, like text size and haptics, should stay in the same Cassette group location, possibly following the variant. The Cassette rows are supposed to be in the "DISPLAY" group. If I move the first row, I'll need to remove it from the Cassette group too, to prevent duplicates. Should I also consider adding text size and haptics to the LOOK group?

**Modifying LOOK group settings**

I’m planning to modify the LOOK group by inserting the _Cycle for the cassette variant right after the screen row, but I notice the LOOK group isn't currently aware of 'instrument' to display it. The rows are part of the "buildGroups" method. If the config type is CassetteScreenConfig, I'll insert the _Cycle for the cassette variant. However, there’s already an existing _Cycle for variant, so I think both can coexist since the cassette variant is unique. How will it all fit together?

**Maintaining cassette variant semantics**

I need to adjust how we handle the cassette’s variant cycle semantics since it should function similarly to what we already have in the Cassette group. This means cycling through variants while saving the screen configuration. To avoid duplicates, I'll remove the variant row from "displayRows," which currently shows three items. The first item will go to the LOOK group, while the DISPLAY group will feature only text size and haptics. I'm curious about how the SOUND group interacts with the Cassette too!

--- lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart
+++ lib/widgets/void_settings_sheet.dart
@@ -399,8 +399,20 @@
             () => settings.saveThemeVariant(_next(
                 const [ThemeVariant.dark, ThemeVariant.light, ThemeVariant.system],
                 settings.themeVariantNotifier.value))),
         _Cycle('void-settings-screen', 'screen', labelFor(cfg.type), cycleScreen),
+        // If Cassette screen is active, show the cassette variant directly below the screen control
+        if (cfg is CassetteScreenConfig) ...[
+          _Cycle(
+            'void-settings-cassette-variant',
+            'variant',
+            cassetteVariantMeta[cfg.variant]!.label,
+            () {
+              final next = CassetteVariant.values[(cfg.variant.index + 1) % CassetteVariant.values.length];
+              settings.saveScreenConfig(cfg.copyWith(variant: next));
+            },
+          ),
+        ],
         _Toggle('void-settings-immersive', 'immersive',
             settings.immersiveNotifier.value,
             () => settings.setImmersive(!settings.immersiveNotifier.value)),
         // Transport strip — bottom / top / off. Browser — fixed vs swipe-up.
